Abstractions and plans

Emmanuel Abbé – EPFL and Apple AIML

Fri, 06-Nov-2026 / 2:30pm / Allen 101X

Abstract

AI reasoning commonly relies on scaling the thinking time. In this talk, we examine how to elevate the thinking process to capture more abstract concepts. Specifically, how to use compression techniques to learn strategic plans that make execution more efficient and robust. We will present applications and formal guarantees for the resulting system.

Bio

Emmanuel Abbé received his Ph.D. degree from the EECS department at MIT. He was a professor at Princeton University and is now a professor at EPFL, as well as a Senior Research Scientist at Apple AIML. He is the recipient of the Bell Labs Prize, the IAS von Neumann Fellowship, the ICML Outstanding Paper Award and twice the IEEE Information Theory Society Award.
